picks.title: Clear dark sky tomorrow 12am
picks.body: 92% clear for about 3 h from 12am, moon 18% lit. Try Maryhill Stonehenge (~120 km away).
why: 3 forecast hours with ≥60% clear sky in darkness (HRRR)

picks.title: Colourful sunrise likely tomorrow 6:58am
picks.body: 47% odds of colour. Best bets: White River Falls State Park, Laurance Lake & Parkdale, Cottonwood Canyon State Park (International Dark Sky Park). Horizon toward the sun is 67% open.
why: 63% chance of a colourful sunrise sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the rising sun 67% open (25–300 km)
picks.lens: 16-50 wide, foreground first; bracket for the bright horizon

picks.title: Sea of fog tomorrow 7:04am
picks.body: 100% chance the valley fills with fog at sunrise. Get above it: Silver Star Mountain, Larch Mountain: Sherrard Point.
why: 100% chance of fog or low cloud in the valley at sunrise (HRRR)
no fresh sounding: assumes viewpoints above 450 m clear the fog
picks.lens: 70-300 to stack the ridges above the fog; 16-50 for the wide view

picks.title: American Wigeon at Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
picks.body: American Wigeon sightings here are near their yearly high this week. Go early: dawn and the two hours after are best.
why: GBIF weekly share of records (presence-only, not encounter odds)
picks.lens: 70-300 (use the 1.5x crop as reach; keep your distance)

note: Odds within 48 h are HRRR; beyond that Open-Meteo, capped at 55% because a single model can't give real odds.
